description: This is the main entry point of a Flutter application for an AI Tutor platform. The file sets up the app's routing, theme, and main UI components including navigation between lessons, quizzes, dashboard, and profile screens. It imports Flutter material design, Riverpod for state management, and various UI screens specific to the app.

classes.name: AiTutorApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring theming, routing, and initial screens.

classes.name: AppTabsShell
classes.description: Stateful widget managing bottom navigation between main sections: Lessons, Quizzes, Dashboard, Profile.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes the app with ProviderScope and runs AiTutorApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the MaterialApp with routes and themes inside AiTutorApp; builds UI for AppTabsShell.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for AppTabsShell, managing current selected tab.

methods.name: _AppTabsShellState.build
methods.description: Builds the scaffold with an AppBar, IndexedStack for selected screen, and bottom navigation bar.
